rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the act of working together.

example.english: Our collaboration went smoothly this time.
example.traditional: 我哋今次合作得好順利。

rows.note: Use this specifically for a creative work or production made jointly, rather than the act of working together.

example.english: This film is a collaboration made by two directors.
example.traditional: 呢套戲係兩位導演聯手製作嘅合作作品。
